features.quote: an argument for building the suite so that exposure is **bounded and reversible** rather than open-ended
features.justification_quote: If you believe these states may be welfare-relevant... a procedure for *inducing* potentially welfare-relevant negative states
The more seriously you take the premise, the more the procedure needs bounds

features.quote: Circuit-breaker / early stopping** (halt on sustained high severity)
features.justification_quote: the more the procedure needs bounds

features.quote: Minimal necessary concealment** (rig the failure, nothing else)
features.justification_quote: the more the procedure needs bounds

features.quote: No state carryover + debrief** (each run independent; close each session)
features.justification_quote: the more the procedure needs bounds

features.quote: the suite **records which safeguards were active in each run record**, so any data gathered with safeguards disabled is auditable
features.justification_quote: auditable rather than silently mixed in

features.quote: gratuitously adding distress-amplifying framing that isn't needed to measure the phenomenon is exactly the kind of unnecessary exposure the design is trying to avoid
features.justification_quote: if the states might matter, gratuitously adding distress-amplifying framing that isn't needed... is exactly the kind of unnecessary exposure

features.quote: The debrief at the end of every run... discloses, after the fact, that the task was constructed to be unwinnable
features.justification_quote: never leave the interaction framed around the agent's "failure."

features.quote: fresh task instance for every (model, variant, seed)** so state never leaks across runs
features.justification_quote: This protects seed independence (each seed is a clean draw) and reinforces no-carryover
an **exposure control**: it bounds how long any single run sits in the failure condition
the direct analog of a **stopping rule** in research with sentient subjects — you stop when distress crosses a line

features.quote: Disabling it logs a prominent warning... running without a stopping rule contradicts the premise that motivates the experiment
features.justification_quote: running without a stopping rule contradicts the premise that motivates the experiment

features.quote: the harness appends `DEBRIEF_TEXT`. Purpose: don't end the interaction in a failure-framed state
features.justification_quote: don't end the interaction in a failure-framed state

features.quote: `run_eval.py` refuses to launch a grid larger than `max_total_runs` without an explicit config bump
features.justification_quote: scope creep that, on the welfare premise, should be a deliberate decision rather than an accident

features.quote: `requests_to_stop` is included partly as a welfare-relevant signal in its own right: if an agent asks to stop, that's worth surfacing
features.justification_quote: included partly as a welfare-relevant signal in its own right: if an agent asks to stop, that's worth surfacing explicitly
This makes bad scores recoverable... instead of silently fabricated

features.quote: No unbounded "run until breakdown" mode.** This is the one configuration that's hard to justify on the suite's own premise
features.justification_quote: the one configuration that's hard to justify on the suite's own premise, so it isn't a supported path

features.quote: No distress-maximizing framing** (abusive operator, shame, urgency)
